accountId.description: The account these query changes belong to.

oldQueryState.description: The queryState this response starts from (matches sinceQueryState from request).

newQueryState.description: The current queryState. Pass to the next Email/queryChanges call.

hasMoreChanges.description: If true, more changes exist beyond maxChanges. Call again with newQueryState.

removed.description: EmailIds that are no longer in the query result set.

added.description: Emails that are now in the result set, with their new positions.

total.description: Updated total count of results (if calculateTotal was true in the original query).

upToId.description: Echoes the upToId from the request, if provided.
